title: Nothing checks that a pause, a sign-out, a new owner code or a new gym writes its log line
what: The database tests check log lines for approving, restoring and trial changes. They never look for the log line of a pause with its reason, a sign-out everywhere, a new owner code, or a new gym with only the last 4 mobile digits.
expected: Each of these actions is checked to leave one log line with its reason, and the new gym's line keeps only the last 4 digits of the mobile.
fix_line: Add a log-line check after each of the four actions in the database test

title: Making a gym for a lead is never tested through HQ
what: No test sends a Make a gym through the HQ server. That the lead moves to demo with the gym code in its note, and that a lead already past called is left alone, is never checked.
expected: A server test makes a gym for a new lead and for a won lead and checks each lead's status and note.
how_often: every gym made for a lead
fix_line: Add a server test for making a gym with and without a lead

title: The limit of 5 owner codes an hour and the old browser key note are never tested
what: HQ refuses a sixth owner code in an hour and adds a note when a gym still has an old browser key. No test makes a sixth code or a gym with such a key.
expected: A test makes six codes and checks the sixth is refused with its words, and a test checks the old key note.
fix_line: Add the sixth-code and old-key cases to the database test

title: The sign-out-everywhere test accepts any count of 3 or more
what: The test only checks at least 3 devices were signed out. A count that also counts devices already signed out, or a second press that does not say 0, would pass.
expected: The test checks the exact count, and that a second press says 0 devices.
fix_line: Check the exact device count and a second press

title: Cancelling a delete request is never tested
what: No test cancels a delete request. That a cancel needs a reason, that the gym keeps working, and that a cancelled request does not block a new one are never checked.
expected: A database test cancels a request with and without a reason, then adds a new request for the same gym.
how_often: each owner who changes their mind
fix_line: Add a cancel case to the delete request test

title: The phone test expects a second pop-up for a corrected reply, while the journey says none
what: HQ sends one push per question only. The phone's own reply check is tested to show one more pop-up when a correction arrives, which is what the journey says must not happen.
expected: The journey and the test agree: either a correction pops up once more, or it only shows in Help and feedback.
fix_line: Pick one rule for a second reply and fix the journey or the test

title: Nothing checks that HQ's log keeps only the length of a reply
what: The reply test lets the log call answer but never reads what it was sent, so the reply words or the question landing in the HQ log would pass.
expected: The test reads the log line and checks it has the length and no words.
fix_line: Read the logged line in the reply test

title: The gym delete request is never tested when it fails to send or for a gym not online
what: The only test of the admin app's delete request has the message reach MettleUp. A failed send, and the button staying hidden for a gym not online, are never checked.
expected: Tests check no success line when the send fails, and no delete button for a gym that is not online.
fix_line: Add a failed-send case and an offline-gym case to the browser test
